login_org.name: Login — Organization ID
login_org.title: Login
login_org.notes: Entry point. User enters their numeric Org ID and clicks Continue.

transitions.notes: Proceeds after Org ID is filled in

login_account_select.name: Login — Select Account
login_account_select.title: Select an Account
login_account_select.notes: SSO account picker via Vanco identity platform. The account tile is an unlabelled button (likely an avatar/image component). 'more' expands account options. User clicks their account tile to proceed.

account_tile.label: (unlabelled)
account_tile.notes: The saved account card — label not readable by inspector, rendered as image/custom component

more.label: more
more.notes: Expands additional options for the saved account

transitions.notes: Selecting the account proceeds to the next login step or dashboard — map next screen

meta.notes: Screens are nodes, transitions are edges. Processes will be named paths through this graph once enough screens are mapped.
